name: Manoj Kumar
current_role: Whole-time Director, RSPL Ltd (RSPL Group, Kanpur); oversees the group's dairy business
profile: Manoj (Kumar) Gyanchandani is the elder son of RSPL founder-chairman Murli Dhar Gyanchandani and a promoter/whole-time director of RSPL Ltd (since 2008), maker of Ghadi detergent. The Kanpur-based group has diversified into dairy (Namaste India), footwear (Red Chief), real estate and 50+ MW of wind/solar power; Manoj runs the dairy arm.
interesting_fact: RSPL operates wind and solar plants across India generating over 50.1 MW of renewable energy, alongside its FMCG business that employs 25,000+ people.
deep_cut_fact: Ghadi broke into a Nirma/Surf-dominated market by making its detergent white (rivals were yellow or blue), with the tagline 'Pehle istemaal karein phir vishwas karein' (First use it, then trust it).
notes: Hurun lists him as 'Manoj Kumar'; company registry (DIN 00049387) shows him as Manoj (Kumar) Gyanchandani, whole-time director of RSPL Ltd. Family is notably low-profile; only the general corporate inbox is published. RSPL renewable-energy arm is a possible energy-podcast angle.
